name: Karkuttle
look: a big teal crab-spider with dark zigzag stripes, a tan hood over sleepy yellow eyes, orange-tipped white fangs, long arching whip antennae, very long legs and huge spiked teal arms with hooked claws
entry: Its legs are so long it can step over a fallen log without slowing down. It waits with its eyes half shut and its antennae spread wide, then lashes out with its claws from three body lengths away.
how: Evolve Whippersnap at level 30. It learns Lunge when it evolves.
Wild: rare in swamps, jungles and on beaches.
